statements.__comment: Clears flags of an earlier run, including anonymous_access* left by the previous version of this job.
statements.query: MATCH (emr:EMRCluster)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE emr.exposed_internet IS NOT NULL OR emr.anonymous_access IS NOT NULL OR emr.publicContext IS NOT NULL WITH emr LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE REMOVE emr.exposed_internet, emr.exposed_internet_type, emr.anonymous_access, emr.anonymous_access_type, emr.publicContext return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted

statements.__comment: The master node is reachable from the internet when it has a public DNS name (public IP in a public subnet) and one of its security groups admits 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0. Account-level EMR Block Public Access says nothing about a given cluster.
statements.query: MATCH (account:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) MATCH (account)-[:RESOURCE]->(emr:EMRCluster) WHERE coalesce(emr.master_public_dns_name, '') <> '' MATCH (cidr)-[:MEMBER_OF_IP_RULE]->(rule:IpPermissionInbound)-[:MEMBER_OF_EC2_SECURITY_GROUP]->(sg:EC2SecurityGroup)<-[:RESOURCE]-(account) WHERE sg.id IN emr.master_security_group_ids AND ((cidr:IpRange AND cidr.range = '0.0.0.0/0') OR (cidr:Ipv6Range AND cidr.range = '::/0')) WITH emr, collect(DISTINCT {securityGroupId: sg.id, protocol: rule.protocol, fromPort: rule.fromport, toPort: rule.toport, ipRange: cidr.range}) AS securityRules SET emr.exposed_internet = true, emr.exposed_internet_type = ['master_public_open_sg'], emr.publicContext = apoc.convert.toJson([{resource: emr.id, resourceType: 'aws-analytics-emr-cluster', context: [{clusterId: emr.id, clusterName: emr.name, state: emr.state, masterPublicDnsName: emr.master_public_dns_name, exposureTypes: ['master_public_open_sg'], securityRules: securityRules}]}])
